subject: [PATCH v2 1/5] mm/page_alloc: detect zonelist rebuilds from memory hot-add

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch detects and handles zonelist rebuilds caused by memory hot-add, which can lead to spurious allocation failures for __GFP_THISNODE callers. The issue arises when onlining a zone's first block rewrites the zonelists in place, causing concurrent allocations to fail. To fix this, the patch gates sequence checks on CONFIG_MEMORY_HOTPLUG instead of just CONFIG_MEMORY_HOTREMOVE, ensuring that all configurations that rebuild zonelists after boot are covered.
